h1: Sea Beach Koh Larn 1 — Big Rooms, Low Price, a Short Walk from Na Ban Pier
intro: Step off the boat at Na Ban Pier, walk a little way into the village, and you are there — this is Sea Beach Koh Larn 1, a 2-star guest house people pick for its location near the pier and rooms that are bigger than you'd expect at this price · Standard and Family House rooms run about 25 sqm, with cold AC, hot water and a fridge, plus a yard out front for parking cars and scooters · It's an easy walk to 7-Eleven, the songthaew stop and village restaurants · Score 7.8 from 128 reviews, from approx. ฿900/night

body.html: Sea Beach Koh Larn 1 is a guest house in Na Ban village — on the same side as Na Ban Pier, about 200 metres' walk from where the boats dock · That's the main draw: if you've dragged your bag off the ferry and don't want to grab a songthaew, you can simply walk to the door · The guest house sits right in the village, with a 7-Eleven, the songthaew stop, restaurants and scooter-rental spots all within easy reach. It suits travellers doing Koh Larn on a budget who use the room as a base and spend their days out at the beaches.

There are two main room types, Standard Room and Family House, both around 25 sqm · What many reviews mention is that the rooms are bigger than you'd expect at this price — some ground-floor units have a sliding door dividing the sleeping area from an inner section with the fridge and the bathroom · All rooms are air-conditioned with hot water, and guests say the AC is genuinely cold and the hot water works · Upper-floor rooms get better light and views, and some cost a little more, so if you want a more open feel it's worth asking about the upstairs rooms when you book.

"Big room, just a short walk from the pier, close to 7-Eleven and the songthaew stop, AC was cold, hot water fine, and there's a yard out front to park a car or scooter — for the price it's good value."

Real guest reviews line up on location and value · Many praise how easy the walk from the pier is, plus being close to the convenience store and the songthaew that takes you out to the various beaches · There's a yard out front to park a rented scooter, along with services like laundry, currency exchange and a shuttle, and staff handle both English and Thai · With prices starting in the low four figures — and dipping below that on some promotions — it's a regular choice for travellers watching their budget.

What to know before you book is that cleanliness and room condition aren't always consistent · Some reviews mention that the corners of the room and the shower drains aren't cleaned thoroughly, that water drains slowly while showering, and that some fittings are worn or broken · A few guests found the beds fairly firm, and there are reports that certain items, like a hair dryer or some services, may carry an extra charge — worth confirming at check-in · This is the kind of thing you find at a guest house in this price band, not a resort, so setting expectations to match makes for a smoother stay.

Honestly, Sea Beach Koh Larn 1 works best for people who weight location near the pier, a spacious room and a low price over polish · If your plan is to step off the boat, walk a couple of hundred metres into the village, drop your bag, then ride a scooter out to Tawaen, Samae and Nual beaches all day before coming back to a big room with cold AC — this place does that job cheaply · But if you want a sea view, a pool or a particularly spotless room, the properties over on Tawaen or Samae beach will fit better.

On price, a Standard Room starts around ฿900/night on weekdays and during promotions, while a Family House that sleeps several climbs to roughly ฿1,300–1,800 depending on the date and number of guests · Weekends and long holidays push prices up and rooms fill quickly, since Koh Larn is a popular day-trip from Pattaya · It's worth comparing several platforms and locking in a free-cancellation rate first, as prices swing quite a bit by date.

If you want a pool or a sea view — this is a village guest house with no pool and no beach frontage → look at resorts or pool villas over on Tawaen or Samae beach instead.
If you'd rather avoid surprise charges — there are reports that some services or items, like a hair dryer, may cost extra → confirm what's included and what isn't at check-in.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Sea Beach Koh Larn 1

faq.q: Where on Koh Larn is Sea Beach Koh Larn 1?
faq.a: It's at 212/5 Moo 7, Na Ban village, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri · It sits on the same side as Na Ban Pier, about 200 metres' walk from where the boats dock · It's near 7-Eleven, the songthaew stop and village restaurants · From the guest house, Tawaen Beach is about 1.3 km, or roughly a 13-minute walk.

faq.q: How much does Sea Beach Koh Larn 1 cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: From approx. ฿900/night for a Standard Room on weekdays and promotions · A Family House sleeping several runs about ฿1,300–1,800 depending on the date and number of guests · It's one of the budget options on the island; weekend and long-holiday rates climb, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Sea Beach Koh Larn 1 have a pool or sea view?
faq.a: No pool and no beach frontage · It's a guest house in Na Ban village; the strengths are its location near the pier, spacious rooms and a low price · If you want a pool or a sea view, look at resorts or pool villas over on Tawaen or Samae beach instead.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Sea Beach Koh Larn 1 — are they spacious?
faq.a: Standard and Family House rooms run about 25 sqm, and many reviews say they're bigger than expected for a guest house at this price, with cold AC and working hot water · The thing to know is that room corners and shower drains may not be cleaned thoroughly, and beds in some rooms are fairly firm — check recent photos and reviews before booking.

faq.q: How do I get to Sea Beach Koh Larn 1?
faq.a: Take the ferry from Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya across to Na Ban Pier on Koh Larn (about 45 minutes) · From the pier it's about a 200-metre walk into Na Ban village to the guest house — no transfer needed · On the island, renting a scooter for around 300 baht/day is the easy way to reach the beaches.

faq.q: Who is Sea Beach Koh Larn 1 best for?
faq.a: It's best for budget travellers who weight a pier-side location and a spacious room, and who spend the day out at the beaches and come back just to sleep · It's less ideal if you want a particularly spotless room, a pool, a sea view or a beachfront resort feel.
